# CLI reference

Source: `provenant help --json`.

Core commands and their everyday options appear here. For every command and
option, see the [complete CLI reference](cli-all.md) or run
`provenant help COMMAND --all`. All options remain accepted.

Only commands and arguments exposed by the help catalogue appear here.
In argument contracts, omitted booleans are false, lists are empty and
bounds are null. Positional arguments have no long flag.

## Global options

Accepted by every command, before or after the subcommand.

| Argument | Contract |
|---|---|
| `--json` | `{"description": "Print machine-readable JSON output", "name": "json", "values": ["true", "false"]}` |
| `--full` | `{"description": "Show all human-readable detail instead of a compact summary", "name": "full", "values": ["true", "false"]}` |
| `--project` | `{"description": "Use this directory as the project", "name": "project"}` |

## `provenant status`

| Argument | Contract |
|---|---|
| `--wait` | `{"bounds": [1, 14400], "conflicts": ["all", "cursor"], "description": "Wait for mixed targets (no value uses domains.wait.timeout_seconds)", "name": "wait"}` |
| `--target` | `{"description": "Observe lane:ID, graph:ID, operation:ID, pr:NUMBER or land:NUMBER (repeatable)", "name": "target", "repeatable": true, "requires": ["wait"]}` |
| `--until` | `{"defaults": ["all"], "description": "Return when all targets are terminal (use &#96;any&#96; for the first transition)", "name": "until", "requires": ["wait"], "values": ["any", "all"]}` |
| `--follow` | `{"defaults": ["false"], "description": "Stream transitions until all targets are terminal or the wait expires", "name": "follow", "requires": ["wait"], "values": ["true", "false"]}` |
| `id` | `{"description": "Show a run, task, attempt or graph ID, or operation:ID for a refusal", "name": "id", "positional": true}` |
| `--all` | `{"defaults": ["false"], "description": "Include full records and older lanes", "name": "all", "values": ["true", "false"]}` |

```json
{
  "constraints": [
    "wait requires at least one target via ID or repeated --target, up to domains.wait.max_targets (default 64); no duration uses domains.wait.timeout_seconds",
    "with --wait, --json emits newline-delimited snapshot/transition events and a final end event; timeout exits 124",
    "follow waits for all targets to be terminal; land targets only observe their PR"
  ],
  "description": "Show graph, node and attempt status",
  "groups": [
    {
      "arguments": [
        "session_stream",
        "stats",
        "by",
        "wait",
        "target",
        "until",
        "follow",
        "id",
        "limit",
        "cursor",
        "all"
      ],
      "multiple": true,
      "name": "Status",
      "required": false
    }
  ]
}
```

## Error codes

Commands the run owner serves put one of these stable codes in the JSON
envelope's `error.code`; `status` and the exit code give its category. Other
owners' codes are in [Schemas](schemas.md#edge-error-codes). Match on the code, never on `error.message`,
which may be reworded.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `INVALID` | The request or a stored run record is invalid. |
| `REFUSED` | The execution context or a policy refused the operation. |
| `WORKTREE_MISSING` | The named local worktree does not exist. |
| `WORKTREE_UNREGISTERED` | The worktree is not registered with Provenant. |
| `OPERATION_CONFLICT` | The operation ID was already used for a different request. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | No run record matches in this scope. |
| `NONTERMINAL` | The attempt has not finished. |
| `PROVIDER_STATE_EXPIRED` | Retention removed the provider state this attempt needs to resume. |
| `CONFLICT` | The run record changed concurrently or is immutable. |
| `CANCELLED` | The call was cancelled. |
| `LANE_DEPTH` | Nested lane depth exceeds the configured maximum. |
| `QUEUE_FULL` | The host queue is full. |
| `CONTENTION` | The run store is contended or the call budget expired. |
| `IO` | Filesystem, database or other I/O failed. |
| `UNSUPPORTED` | The route or adapter does not support the requested launch. |
| `CONTINUATION_UNSUPPORTED` | The attempt's provider session cannot be continued. |
| `TIME` | The host clock could not be read. |
| `ENTROPY` | The host could not supply random identifiers. |
| `LANE_CONTEXT` | The lane environment is missing or inconsistent. |
| `IDENTITY` | The project or actor identity could not be resolved. |
| `CONFIG` | Configuration could not be loaded or is invalid. |
| `SHARED_SETTINGS_NEVER_SYNCED` | Identity and credential settings cannot be shared between accounts. |
| `UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT` | The requested account is not registered. |
| `DUPLICATE_PACING_PROFILE` | Multiple pacing profiles resolve to the same account. |
| `GIT` | Git is unavailable or a Git query failed. |
| `SECRET_INPUT` | The prompt or input appears to contain a secret. |
| `WORKTREE_REQUIRED` | The requested mode needs a worktree. |
| `WORKTREE_NOT_APPLICABLE` | A worktree was given for a mode that does not use one. |
| `PARENT_ATTEMPT` | The parent attempt is missing or cannot start children. |
| `INTERNAL` | An internal invariant failed. |
| `LIMIT` | A requested size or count exceeds its bound. |
| `PRICES` | Plan prices could not be read or are invalid. |
| `FABRIC` | A Fabric operation failed. |
| `STATE_CORRUPT` | A stored record or artifact is corrupt. |
| `LAUNCH_UNKNOWN` | The launch handoff was not confirmed; reconcile the run. |
| `UNKNOWN_HOST` | No configured peer has this host label. |
| `PEER_UNAVAILABLE` | The peer host could not be reached. |
| `PEER_VERSION` | The peer host runs an incompatible version. |
| `OWNER_UNAVAILABLE` | The run owner is unavailable in this build or host. |
| `BASE_UNREACHABLE` | The Git base cannot be resolved or fetched. |
| `BRANCH_EXISTS` | The branch already exists. |
| `lane_coordination_refused` | Lane coordination policy refused the operation. |
| `UPGRADE_REFUSED` | The upgrade was refused. |
| `upgrade_required` | A record needs a newer Provenant to read it. |
| `TIMEOUT` | The wait budget expired. |
| `PEER` | The peer host returned an error. |
| `WRITER_SCOPE` | The writer worktree scope was refused. |
| `WRITER_BUSY` | The writer or its lock is held by another operation. |
| `WRITER_LOCK_BUSY` | The writer registry lock is held by another operation. |
| `WRITER_UNKNOWN` | Writer custody could not be determined. |
| `CREDENTIAL_ROOT` | A requested grant overlaps a credential root. |
| `WRITER_PROJECT_MISMATCH` | The writer worktree belongs to a different project than the selected one. |
| `CONFINEMENT` | Confinement refused the requested access. |
| `DISK_FLOOR` | Free disk space is below gc.free_floor; run `provenant gc --apply`. |
| `HOST_PROCESSES` | The user process limit has insufficient headroom. |
| `MEMORY_PRESSURE` | Host memory pressure is too high to admit a lane. |
| `MEMORY_FLOOR` | Available host memory is below the advisory admission floor. |
| `STALE_READINESS` | The selected account's readiness observation is stale. |
| `LANE_CAP` | The host or project lane cap is reached. |
| `BUILD_SETTINGS` | The host lane build settings are invalid. |
| `GUARDIAN_IDENTITY` | The guardian process identity could not be observed. |
| `HOST_CLOCK` | Startup spacing cannot be judged: the monotonic clock or boot identity is unreadable. |
| `WRITER_IMPORT_RETAINED` | A predecessor writer import remains unresolved. |
| `OBJECT_IMPORT_LIMIT` | A lane's Git object import exceeded its limits. |
